strategy.title: Email-sell obituary syndication workbooks to licensed funeral homes, gated on a measured close rate
strategy.why: Price ($200), payer, buying signal (posted 2026-11-23), reachable channel (published business emails), market (600 licensed homes), Brain-produced delivery ($5 cost, no capital) and 5-day time to cash are all sourced. The target needs 20 paid deals, 3.3% of the 600 homes; the close rate is the one unknown and only a live outreach test can measure it.

alternatives.title: Wait for published conversion benchmarks
alternatives.why: Research question is parked; a live test measures the actual rate faster and at no cost.

steps.label: Email the first 200 licensed funeral homes at their published business addresses
Offer the obituary syndication workbook at $200, payment on order
Measure paid orders from the first 200 contacts by day 10
If proven, email the remaining 400 homes
Produce and deliver each workbook on order
Collect $200 per order; all settled by day 26

cash.label: Direct cost $5 x 5, paid from proceeds
Direct cost $5 x 15, paid from proceeds

quantities.name: conversionRate
quantities.needs: Live outreach test: paid orders among the first 200 contacted homes; need at least 3.3% (20 of 600)

sources.claim: 600 funeral homes are licensed by the state board; each publishes obituaries weekly.
sources.population: Licensed funeral homes in the state

validation.proof: At least 5 paid orders (2.5%) from the first 200 contacted funeral homes by day 10, projecting >=20 of 600
stop: Fewer than 3 paid orders from 200 contacts by day 10 (projects <9 of 600, under half the target)
Any paid order refunded or disputed for non-fit of the workbook
continue: 5 or more paid orders by day 10: email the remaining 400 homes
3-4 paid orders: email the remaining 400 and re-check at day 18 against 15 cumulative orders
